structured_output.what_is_happening: RICHARD (ETHWM…pump) is a 10-day-old pump.fun coin that already migrated. It is named after "Richard Strocher", a well-known satirical troll persona on X. It came back to life about 15 minutes ago, during a sudden burst of at least 10 new copycat RICHARD/RichardStrocher tokens launched around 01:50–02:00 UTC on 2026-09-26. The biggest copycat (4NU72…) traded $1.23M in one hour but is now down 58% over the hour and 50% over 5 minutes. This older coin rose about 350% in the hour, probably from people buying it as the "original", and was already down 31% over 5 minutes at T2. Market cap is about $11k with about $7.9k of liquidity. I could not find out what set off the burst: no news for September 2026, and I could not read X.

narrative.why_spreading: Unknown. A dozen same-name launches at the same moment suggests a fresh trigger on X, possibly the account posting or a viral moment. I could not verify this because X is paywalled or not indexed.

But the creator is a mass launcher (21,575 tokens via rapidlaunch) and has closed out, so it is not an official project coin.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat-swarm flush on a known troll-persona meme with no identified catalyst. This old coin caught a spillover pump that is already reversing, the attention is split and the leader is collapsing. There is a small chance it becomes the OG Schelling point, but most likely it chops or drifts lower.
